name: co2_scd41
title: CO2 sensor
purpose: CO2 (and humidity, temperature) sensor, Sensirion SCD41 on I2C, on its own 3.3 V regulator

sources.title: Sensirion SCD4x datasheet, version 1.7 (April 2025)
sources.licence: copyright Sensirion: link and quotes only
sources.read: p5 pin assignment, supply and typical circuit; p24 package outline and land pattern

sources.title: Sensirion SCD4x design-in guide
sources.licence: copyright Sensirion: link and quotes only

sources.title: KiCad 10 standard libraries (symbols, footprints, 3D models)
sources.read: symbol pin numbers, footprint pads, 3D models

parts.source: scd4x, p5, p24; kicad (footprint copied into footprints/air.pretty with our own box model: KiCad has no 3D model of it)
parts.quote: "VDD and VDDH must be connected to each other close to the sensor on the customer PCB."; DNC: "Do not connect, pads must be soldered to a floating pad on the customer PCB"

/VDD_CO2.note: its own LDO: "Operating the sensor with a separate LDO is recommended." (scd4x p5)

layout.rules: Far from heat sources: "Significant heat sources within devices typically ... voltage regulators and batteries" (scd4x_designin 1.2); a slit in the board beside it is the guide's best option (not done: the harness draws only a rectangular outline). I2C address 0x62.

open_questions: No slit in the board next to the sensor (the design-in guide's best option for heat); placed at the far end from the regulators instead.
The datasheet's circuit has no decoupling capacitor at the sensor; the separate LDO's own output capacitors are its only ones.
